description: Source file for a fact-checking service in a backend application. Contains asynchronous functions for processing claims, updating databases, fetching sources from Wikipedia and Google Search Console, scoring sources, and broadcasting updates through WebSocket. Defines core operational logic for claim analysis and result dissemination.

classes.name: AnalysisSummary
classes.description: Data model representing a summary of the analysis including claim ID, textual summary, and score.

classes.name: SourceItem
classes.description: Data model representing a source item with attributes like reliability score and stance.

methods.name: None _update_claim(claim_id: str, updates: dict, event_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Internal function to update claim document in database and optionally send WebSocket event.

methods.name: float _score_sources(sources: List[SourceItem])
methods.description: Calculates a naive score for a list of sources based on their reliability and stance.

methods.name: None process_claim(claim_id: str)
methods.description: Main asynchronous function orchestrating the fact-checking pipeline for a specific claim ID.
